text: Figure 9.21: Editor view of Data Constraint Definitions Data Constraints: In this section all necessary data constraint rule definitions are collected. If more than one data constraint rule of the same type is available the definitions are rated by their Level information. According to AUTOSAR Software Component T emplate [3] the Levels are defined as: • 0: This represents so called hard limits. They shall always be specified. • 1: This represents so called soft limits. Soft limits may be violated after confirmation by the user of an MCD-System. Other values may exist, but the semantics is outside the AUTOSAR scope. T o avoid too complex dependencies between several limitations, for the definition of Application Interfaces, we restrict the number of data constraint definitions to one per data type. Data constraints can be defined as Internal or Physical value representation. For the definition of physical data constraint rules, a reference to a physical unit is mandatory . Internal value representation cannot be standardized on VFB level because this depends on the implementation method. This is not in the focus of Application Interface definitions.
